items.title: 14.5 Impact of human activities on the atmosphere

blocks.text: Human activities have a significant impact on the atmosphere, primarily through the burning of fossil fuels and deforestation; these contribute to climate change, air pollution, poor air quality and other environmental issues. In urban areas most air pollution comes from human-made sources, mobile (cars, trucks, aeroplanes, marine engines) or point sources (factories, power plants).

blocks.prompt: Describe four human activities that worsen air quality, naming a pollutant for each (exercise Q.2d).
blocks.explanation: Burning fossil fuels in vehicles releases CO, NOx and VOCs; burning coal in power plants and brick kilns releases SO2 and particulate matter; deforestation and burning crop residues release CO2 and smoke particles; industry, metallurgy and waste incineration release heavy metals such as lead and mercury.

items: Human impact mainly through fossil fuel burning and deforestation; urban pollution from mobile and point sources.
